test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 03 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a row, facing north. No one sits to the right of C. Only three people sit between C and D. Only two people sit between D and G. A sits third to the left of F. B sits to the immediate right of F. How many people sit to the right of B?
solution:
Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a row, facing north.

1. No one sits to the right of C.

2. Only three people sit between C and D.

3. Only two people sit between D and G.

4. A sits third to the left of F.

5. B sits to the immediate right of F. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04c174837174a171e1fb8314de8d7406ffe8ece31b25b5f5b03976ac39186fc0.png] 

Two people sit to the right of B.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 3**”.
